Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a reticulonodular pattern with relative sparing of the costophrenic angles (bases), which is a hallmark radiographic feature of Pulmonary Langerhans' Cell Histiocytosis (LCH). Although pleural effusions are rare in LCH, Option B is the only choice that correctly identifies the characteristic upper/mid-zone predominance and basal sparing seen in the image, distinguishing it from the other options which describe incorrect distributions or patterns.
